summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) reporting the appointment of Torchlight Loan Services, LLC as special servicer for the Cummins Station mortgage loan combination under the BANK5 2024-5YR8 PSA, replacing Greystone Servicing Company LLC at the direction of 400 Capital Management LLC. This is a routine servicing administration change within a CMBS structure, with no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or other special situation event. There are no deal terms, consideration, premiums, or shareholder actions. The filing does not constitute a special situation category.
